name: Book Employee with Spouse — Invalid City Then Valid
goal: User enters an invalid city for the selected state; bot rejects and user provides a valid city.
constraints: First city input is not in allowed list for the chosen state; second is valid.

phases.description: User provides spouse details, appointment date, mobile, and state.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name, DOB, appointment date, mobile, and state.
Bot replies with 'This is not a city where we have this facility. Please try another location.'
Bot confirms booking and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
